name: Exp_ColorJJRSX
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJJRSX indicator, which combines Jurik RSX (raw signal index) with JMA (Jurik Moving Average) smoothing. It generates buy signals when the JJRSX histogram turns upward and sell signals when it turns downward, with separate controls for entering and exiting positions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJJRSX指标进行交易，该指标融合了Jurik RSX原始信号指数与JMA平滑移动平均线。当JJRSX柱状图由下转上时产生买入信号，由上转下时产生卖出信号，并分别控制开仓和平仓权限。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Jurik RSX动量指标经JMA平滑后的方向变化来捕捉趋势动量。入场条件：当Value[1]<Value[2]（指标值上升）且Value[0]>Value[1]时开多仓；当Value[1]>Value[2]（指标值下降）且Value[0]<Value[1]时开空仓。出场条件：多仓在指标下降时平仓，空仓在指标上升时平仓，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制存款份额，支持自由保证金、余额、损失比例和固定手数四种计算模式。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的标准函数，但没有动态调整止损或追踪止损机制。整体策略属于动量跟踪类型，依赖指标斜率变化而非绝对阈值来产生信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on directional changes in the Jurik RSX momentum indicator after JMA smoothing to capture trend momentum. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when Value[1]<Value[2] (indicator rising) and Value[0]>Value[1] (confirmed upward momentum), while a sell position opens when Value[1]>Value[2] (indicator falling) and Value[0]<Value[1] (confirmed downward momentum). Exit conditions: long positions close when the indicator starts declining, and short positions close when the indicator starts rising, supplemented by fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit in points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter representing the share of deposit per deal, with four calculation modes including free margin, balance, loss share, and fixed lot. Money management relies on standard functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, but lacks dynamic stop adjustments or trailing stop mechanisms. The overall strategy is a momentum-following type that depends on indicator slope changes rather than absolute threshold levels for signal generation.

parameters.description: 手数计算方法（自由保证金/余额/损失比例/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation method (fixed lot or proportional)

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description_en: Maximum price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 使用Jurik指标家族，RSX+JMA双重平滑减少虚假信号
买卖开仓和平仓权限分离，灵活性高
支持多种资金管理模式，适应不同交易风格
在新K线形成时才计算信号，避免重复入场
pros_en: Uses the Jurik indicator family with RSX+JMA double smoothing to reduce false signals
Separate permissions for buy/sell opening and closing provide high flexibility
Supports multiple money management modes adapting to different trading styles
Calculates signals only on new bar formation to avoid repeated entries
cons: 止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率动态调整
缺少追踪止损机制，盈利头寸可能大幅回吐
没有价差过滤，在高点差环境下可能频繁触发虚假信号
依赖外部自定义指标ColorJJRSX，部署时需确保指标文件可用
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit are fixed points without dynamic adjustment for market volatility
Lacks trailing stop mechanism, so profitable positions may give back significant gains
No spread filter, which may cause frequent false signals in high-spread environments
Depends on the external custom ColorJJRSX indicator, requiring the indicator file to be available at deployment
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈机制，根据市场波动率自动调整
添加追踪止损功能以锁定浮动利润
加入价差过滤和交易时段过滤，减少不利条件下的交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit that adjusts automatically with market volatility
Implement a trailing stop feature to lock in floating profits
Add spread filter and trading session filter to reduce trades under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 固定止损止盈不能适应不同市场波动环境，极端行情下保护不足
没有价差过滤在高波动时段可能导致滑点过大
指标参数较多且优化空间大，存在过度拟合风险
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss and take profit cannot adapt to different market volatility environments, providing insufficient protection in extreme conditions
No spread filter may cause excessive slippage during high-volatility periods
Many indicator parameters with large optimization space create risk of overfitting
